definition: End-of-waste profile: the legal state transition by which a material ceases to be waste, recorded as the issuance event of a new passport for the re-qualified material

manifest.issuing_role: accredited actor (notified-body pattern, EN 18239 notified-actor roles); the recycler holds the waste-side record, the accredited actor issues the re-qualification

legal_basis.citation: Art. 6 (end-of-waste status: specified use, market or demand, technical requirements, no adverse impact), Art. 5 (by-products) as the neighbouring doctrine

legal_basis.instrument: National end-of-waste decisions and EU-level criteria where adopted

manifest.notes: The doctrinal point: end-of-waste is not an attribute edit on a waste record — it is NEW passport issuance (invariant I7: passports issue where legal duty attaches; the duty changes at re-qualification). The output passport is derived (R2 derivation edge, inputReferences to the waste-side passports, as-of-state hashes); waste-side inputs transition to consumed/transformed and remain verifiable for as-of queries. The demonstration implements the trigger verbatim: the end-of-waste event carries its criteria evidence reference and is issued by an accredited actor (B10). The subsequent SRM applicability binding onto the new identity is the registry's retroactive dated binding — it legally applies from the decision instant even if registered later.

transforms.method_citation: Basel Annexes to EU List of Waste correspondence

triggers.description: waste-status exit event with criteria met (Art. 6 conditions evidenced: use specified, demand, technical fitness, no adverse effects)
